name: HV and LV cables with cable trays and accessories
description: HV and LV cables with cable trays and accessories for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Procurement / Electrical. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts. Primary source: https://r.jina.ai/https://mx.prysmian.com/sites/mx.prysmian.com/files/media/documents/E230FK90800MIDNE%20132%20kV%20XLP%20800%20mm2%20Cu%20LS0H-SC%20IEC%2060840.pdf
